assessed_images.observation: S7 explicitly characterizes a synthetic product mixture from equilibrium lactam formation and depicts the five-membered hemiaminal. The reported 1:1 epimers and NMR conditions cannot establish an intracellular Newman distribution.
Figure S2 depicts SB1 with the terminal hemiaminal ring and an unspecified ring stereocenter. Figure S3 separately depicts epi-SB2; it is not interchangeable with SB1.

Thesis page98 Figure4-7 and surrounding text report SbnB primarily dimeric in solution, with approximate DLS and MALS mass estimates. NAD/NADH occupancy in structures is discussed separately and does not establish a fixed catalytic cofactor stoichiometry.
